A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''Inquisitor''' had worked with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] in a [[Cephalon study|study]] of [[Cephalon|Cephalons]]. The study had resulted in the scientists finding Cephalons had at least nine distinct emotional states, three of which had only a faint resemblance to to the emotions experienced by most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]]. Though more emotional states were theorized to be possible. Rumor had it that the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] that partook in the experiment had gone mad while trying to wrap his head around the varying states of the Cephalon's four-dimensional consciousness. [[Den Dhur]] found the rumor to be a comforting image shortly before negotiating with a Cephalon.<ref name="CNII:SOS" />
